name: @pipeworx/mcp-brazil-cvm-financials

tools.name: br_financials
tools.description: Annual financial statements (DFP) of a Brazilian listed company from CVM open data: balance sheet, income statement, cash flow and value added, as account lines with CVM account codes and Portuguese labels, in full BRL. Identify the company by cnpj (e.g. "00.000.000/0001-91" or 14 digits) or by name (e.g. "Petrobras"; an ambiguous name returns candidates instead of a guess). year is the fiscal reference year (default: latest loaded). scope is "consolidated" or "individual" (default: consolidated when the company filed one, else individual -- the response says which). Only the latest filing version is kept; the response states it. statement narrows to one of BPA (assets), BPP (liabilities and equity), DRE (income), DFC_MI / DFC_MD (cash flow indirect / direct), DVA (value added). max_depth (default 2) limits account-code depth so a default call returns the headline lines; raise it for sub-accounts. Results page with limit/offset and report truncated/total_matching. A company or year not in the data returns found:false with data_as_of, never an empty success.

cnpj.description: Company CNPJ, formatted or 14 digits. Pass cnpj or name.

name.description: Company name, e.g. "Petrobras", "Itau Unibanco". Accents optional.

year.description: Fiscal reference year, e.g. 2024. Default: latest loaded for that company.

scope.description: Default consolidated if filed, else individual.

tools.name: br_financials_search
tools.description: Search Brazilian listed companies in the CVM annual-statements data by name (every word must appear; accents ignored), returning cnpj, name, CVM code and the fiscal years available. Use it to find the cnpj to pass to br_financials or br_financial_series. A query matching nothing returns found:false with data_as_of, never an empty list.

name.description: Company name or part of it, e.g. "vale", "banco do brasil".

tools.name: br_financial_series
tools.description: One CVM account across fiscal years for a Brazilian listed company -- e.g. account_code "3.01" for the income-statement top line, "1" for total assets, "2.03" for equity -- in full BRL with the account label, scope and filing version of each year. Pass cnpj or name. Account codes follow the CVM chart (1 assets, 2 liabilities and equity, 3 income statement, 6 cash flow, 7 value added); labels and meaning differ between banks/insurers and industrials, and the label is returned per year so a change is visible. Years the company did not file the account are listed in missing_years rather than dropped. A code the company never reported returns found:false with data_as_of.

cnpj.description: Company CNPJ, formatted or 14 digits. Pass cnpj or name.

from_year.description: First fiscal year (default: the earliest this company filed).

to_year.description: Last fiscal year (default: the latest this company filed).

scope.description: Default: consolidated where filed, else individual (each row says which).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-brazil-cvm-financials forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the brazil-cvm-financials pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
